rationale: The published map remains the source of geometry, presentation, labels, routes, origins, and guidance. The optional TABLE only overlays operational visitor status by stable destination ID.

behavior.unbound: render the bundled synthetic status sample while keeping every map-defined destination available
behavior.boundEmpty: render all map destinations without operational badges
behavior.invalidRows: ignore rows without a destinationId and normalize invalid wait values to no wait
behavior.unknownDestination: ignore status rows whose destinationId is absent from the current map
behavior.availability: disable route start for unavailable destinations and show the datasource note
behavior.liveUpdate: update availability, wait time, and notices without rebuilding the map scene
